name: Partner percent resolved zero/null - no discount applied
what_it_tests: A partner deal where the resolved PartnerDiscountPercent is null or not >0 (incl. incomplete product hierarchy falling back to 0%) yields no discount
proc_mechanism: Partner Percent Resolved Filter (PartnerDiscountPercent IsNotNull AND GreaterThan 0) negative branch; hierarchy fallback Solution Category->Group->Unit->0%
expected_behavior: No partner discount; net unchanged at list
test_setup: Deal_Type__c='Partner Originated', PartnerDiscountPercent=0/null or product missing Solution_Category__c
